note: One handshake, LP-10602, made against the PUBLISHED libraries. The RESP frame was written by github.com/luxfi/node/mesh/peer.RunPQHandshakeConn, which signs through cloudflare/circl mldsa65.SignTo(..., randomized=false); the INIT frame is the one Go accepted, signed through luxfi/crypto's mldsa65_sign_ctx_det (v1.20.11). aead_key is the key GO derived, and both ends derived it. Both ML-DSA secrets are here so both signatures can be RE-MADE, which is what deterministic signing is for. Frames are message bodies: the 4-byte big-endian length that precedes each on the wire is not included. Made with: pqgo <pub> <priv> '' 127.0.0.1:PORT   and   pq_vector_test --against 127.0.0.1:PORT <data dir>.
